articles.title: Former Robinhood engineer pleads guilty to insider trading scheme on Hyperliquid
articles.snippet: Huaisong Xiang admitted using confidential crypto listing information to make $125,523 trading perpetual futures on Hyperliquid.

articles.title: Zelle picks Solana for ZelleUSD stablecoin and international payments
articles.snippet: Zelle plans to use Solana for its ZelleUSD stablecoin and international payments, with confidential transfers designed to hide payment amounts.

articles.title: Coinone warns of phishing, identity theft after customer data breach
articles.snippet: The South Korean crypto exchange said potentially exposed information includes passwords, bank account numbers, national identification numbers and crypto wallet addresses.
